findings.comment: IPAddress.NetworkToHostOrder((short)...) returns a signed 16-bit short. When the port number is in the range 32768-65535 (such as ephemeral/dynamic client ports), the short value is negative, and converting it to int sign-extends it into a negative integer.

IPAddress.NetworkToHostOrder((short)...) returns a signed 16-bit short. When the IPv6 port number is in the range 32768-65535, returning it as int sign-extends the negative short value into a negative integer.
